answer: Each bonded identity locks collateral in escrow, so splitting stake among aliases does not dilute liability: when k coordinated identities equivocate, their base penalty scales as O(k²). Upon detection, an exponential multiplier increases the swarm’s capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation makes impaired collateral recover more slowly. Whether identities are named sonnet, opal, or ledge, consensus evidence links their correlated signatures rather than trusting labels.
